assessment: The authors present cellular and genetic data, combining mutant analysis and RNA-sequencing, that together support a functional role for Shh in repressing the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in the developing larynx during larynx-esophageal separation. In the absence of Shh, cells undergo EMT and are replaced with a novel epithelial cell population of unknown origin. These results make a significant contribution to the field by illuminating how the larynx develops.
